whatIs.a: Novala is an all-in-one business management platform for Canadian small and mid-size businesses. It brings together payroll, accounting, invoicing, workforce management, and reporting in a single connected system.

easyToLearn.a: Yes. Novala is designed for business owners, not accountants. The platform provides a guided experience from day one with an interactive setup wizard, built-in help, and Vela your AI assistant that answers questions in plain English.

cost.a: Pricing depends on the size of your business and the modules you need. Small businesses typically start at competitive monthly rates. Contact us for a personalized quote or start with a free trial to see the value first.

payroll.q: Does Novala handle payroll in Canada?
payroll.a: Yes. Novala handles Canadian payroll with full CRA compliance built in. Federal and provincial tax calculations, CPP, EI, T4s, T4As, ROEs, and payroll remittances are all automated.

expenses.q: Can Novala track my business expenses?
expenses.a: Yes. Novala connects to your business bank accounts to automatically import and categorize transactions. Snap receipts with your phone, tag expenses to projects or clients, and get real-time reporting on where your money goes.
